# Findymail

Findymail is a B2B email and phone data provider offering verified contact information, email verification, automated exports, and CRM enrichment to enhance sales prospecting and outreach efforts.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/findymail/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact List**: Create a new contact list.
- **Delete Contact List**: Delete a specified contact list by its id.
- **Find Email by Name** (read-only): Find someone's email using their full name and company domain.
- **Get Contact Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all contact lists.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve contacts from a specified list (paginated).
- **Verify Email**: Verify the deliverability of an email address.
